_warning: TEST ONLY - NEVER PRODUCTION. These vectors fix the framing of the identity blob. They contain no key material because none of it is secret.
_what_is_and_is_not_here: The header and the additional-entropy construction are frozen here byte for byte. A complete sealed blob is NOT, and cannot be: the wrapped body is DPAPI output, which is bound to a user account and a machine by design, so it is not reproducible anywhere else. A vector file containing one would be a vector nobody but its author could verify.

headers.name: version 1, dpapi user scope, empty body

notes: The two entries share an entropy string and differ in header: that is QYR-0048. wrapped_len is in the header and deliberately not in the entropy, because it is not known until after the wrapper has run.
reserved is bytes 10..12 and must be zero. A non-zero value is rejected, not ignored.
